description: A Minecraft Forge client mod for toggling sneak and auto-sprint behavior.

releases.notes:
## Mod Version 1.1.0 for Minecraft 1.2.5

Backports the ToggleSneak 1.1.0 feature updates to the Minecraft 1.2.5 version.

### Changes
- Ported ToggleSneak to Minecraft Forge/ModLoader 1.2.5.
- Added file-based configuration through config/togglesneak.cfg.
- Added HUD enable/disable config option.
- Added option for the Sprint key to untoggle Sneak.
- Updated Sprint behavior to automatically engage while moving forward when enabled.
- Removed the old key-hold timing config option.
- Updated README and mod metadata for the current behavior.

releases.notes:
## ToggleSneak v1.1.0 for Minecraft 26.1.2

Updated ToggleSneak for Minecraft 26.1.2 / Forge 64.0.9.

### Changes
- Ported the mod to modern Forge for Minecraft 26.1.2.
- Added Forge mod config screen support.
- Added configurable HUD visibility.
- Added an option for the Sprint key to untoggle Sneak.
- Updated sneak/sprint handling for the newer Minecraft input system.
